research_boundary: Investigate whether the August 2026 Abu Duhur strike reporting supports the bounded claim that the event produced both a public U.S.-Israeli prior-warning dispute and a Turkey-presence linkage. Collect original AP lineage, U.S. envoy or official-language material, Israeli official or security-source dispute/linkage material, and Turkish or Arabic/Syrian environment context. Collapse syndicated copies, keep interested-source statements separate from factual corroboration, and do not assess the claim without independent lineage coverage.
